INSERT INTO wms_stock_flow (biz_type, doc_id, doc_no, warehouse_id, location_id, material_id, batch_no, qty, biz_price, cost_price, cost_amount, partner_id, partner_name, create_by, create_time) VALUES
(#{f.bizType}, #{f.docId}, #{f.docNo}, #{f.warehouseId}, #{f.locationId}, #{f.materialId}, #{f.batchNo}, #{f.qty}, #{f.bizPrice}, #{f.costPrice}, #{f.costAmount}, #{f.partnerId}, #{f.partnerName}, #{f.createBy}, #{f.createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_stock_flow SET cost_price = #{costPrice}, cost_amount = #{costAmount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql:
FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = f.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc sd ON f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT', 'TRANSFER') AND sd.id = f.doc_id LEFT JOIN wms_check ck ON f.biz_type = 'CHECK' AND ck.id = f.doc_id WHERE f.material_id = #{q.materialId}
AND f.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} AND f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER' AND w.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN'
COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN sd.receive_date END, sd.biz_date, ck.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE))
